lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns posterior to the branchial region, with a dense concentration of local maxima in the mid-lateral section.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like grid, most prominent in the central region of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the superior third of the flank, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow transition from the dorsal to ventral aspect.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin surface displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots across its distal and medial regions.
